original_prototype.name: bounded-reader-v3
original_prototype.note: The independently reviewed bounded-reader-v3 prototype was copied unchanged into this vendor directory; only Cargo.toml differs for the Oxide-scoped path build.

modifications.Cargo.toml: Registry workspace inheritance replaced with explicit pinned dependency versions so this vendor copy is consumed only through the Oxide path dependency. The main workspace excludes this directory so the original vendor integration tests do not join the workspace test run.
modifications.src/storage.rs: Cache whole-storage verification results (including typed failures) per retained ZIP owner and storage key, so independently named aliased tensors do not rehash their backing storage; preserve extent, CRC0 and compression checks and bounded 64KiB CRC streaming. Real stored-ZIP alias/concurrent-key/corruption/independent-owner regressions use a test-only streamed-CRC counter.

licenses.notice: See NOTICE. Full upstream license texts are retained verbatim.
licenses.note: License texts are the full upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 texts; their hashes match the independently reviewed V3 prototype and the staged public artifacts.

modification_revision: Local CRC-alias followup on V2: storage.rs now caches whole-storage verification per archive/storage key; all other prototype source files remain unchanged.
